summary: 文章回顾玛格丽特·梅喜的小说与图画书，说明她怎样以想象力和语言连接不同年龄的读者。新作、再版作品和读者回忆共同勾勒出她的文学影响。

paragraphs.brief: 玛格丽特·马希在长达五十年的职业生涯中，在新西兰占据了独特的地位，以创新的虚构和原创性写作。
sentences: In a career spanning some fifty years, Margaret Mahy has come to occupy a unique place in New Zealand writing with innovative fiction and original characterisation.
玛格丽特·马希在长达五十年的职业生涯中，在新西兰占据了独特的地位，以创新的虚构和原创性写作。

In our solidly realist tradition, the linguistic fireworks of Mahy’s children’s fiction and the explorations of human behaviour at the heart of her supernatural teenage fiction stand gloriously alone.
在我们牢固的现实主义传统中，马希儿童小说的语言烟火以及她超自然的青少年小说的核心对人类行为的探索，都光荣地单独存在。
Mahy’s clearest heir, I have always thought, is Elizabeth Knox — and maybe the true inheritance there is sheer singularity.
我总是认为，Mahy最清楚的继承人是Elizabeth Knox，也许真正的继承人就是独一无二。
Just as there is no one else like Knox in New Zealand writing, Mahy, too, has ventured into imaginative territory unknown to other local writers.
正如新西兰没有其他人像诺克斯一样写作，马希也冒险进入了其他地方作家所不知道的富有想象力的领域。
So it was with great pleasure that I visited Mahy recently at her Governor’s Bay home to talk about her new book.
我很高兴最近来到马希，在她的州长湾的家里，谈论她的新书。

As with all journalists, she is generous to a fault with her time and attention; and, as always — despite her careful consideration of questions and thoughtful answers — I’m reminded she isn’t truly comfortable making herself or her life the heart of any conversation.
与所有记者一样，她总是在时间和注意力上大方，而且，尽管她仔细考虑了问题和深思熟虑的答案，但她还是提醒我，她并没有真正将自己的生活作为任何对话的核心。

paragraphs.brief: 当然，任何对马希小说和图片书风格的思考都会引出一些不可抗拒的理论。
sentences: Certainly, any consideration of the style of Mahy’s novels and picture books throws up some irresistible theories.
当然，任何对马希小说和图片书风格的思考都会引出一些不可抗拒的理论。
As a writer committed to supporting herself through her art, she has seldom had the time for formal research.
作为一位致力于通过艺术支持自己的作家，她很少有时间进行正式研究。

Rather, it has been a matter of going out and finding inspiration from her immediate environment: the writing on the side of a bus; a spelling mistake in a note to herself; the similarity between a cat and a fur hat.
相反，这是从她眼前的环境寻找灵感的问题：公共汽车边上的写作；给自己写一个字条上的拼写错误；猫和毛帽之间的相似性。

But despite these sometimes mundane origins, the settings for her stories are delightfully varied, as these books celebrate the dramatic plot twists and unpredictability of adventures on the high seas or in Antarctica, and also in quite unassuming places like the library or even down the back of a chair at home.
但尽管有时是平凡的起源，她故事的布局却千差万别，因为这些书赞美了在公海或南极洲，以及图书馆或甚至在家里的椅子背面的奇幻的图案曲折和不可预测的冒险。
Mahy has a lifelong affection for characters who are agents of upheaval and disturbance.
Mahy一生都喜欢那些制造动乱和动乱的人
Her junior and picture books are peppered with pirates, robbers and lions, though they appear alongside librarians, mothers and children, working against comfortable stereotype.
她的书和照片书上充斥着海盗、强盗和狮子，尽管他们与图书管理员、母亲和儿童一起出现，努力消除舒适的定型观念。
Her fictions often have at their heart a young adult burdened with special powers, such as the ability to cast spells in order to transform their world in supernatural and fantastical ways.
她的虚构故事往往让一个年轻成年人背负着特殊的力量比如施咒的能力以超自然和神奇的方式改变他们的世界

Another common feature is that, while the conclusions of her tales are usually predictable, they leave the reader feeling absolutely complete, the moral questions resulting from our hero’s powers having been resolved.
另一个共同特征是，虽然她的故事结论通常可以预测，但读者认为这些结论绝对完整，我们英雄的力量所产生的道德问题已经解决。

paragraphs.brief: 现在，它有一半的原始尺寸，是一个令人着迷的读物—— 一个冒险，一个浪漫，和一个金矿 Mahy文学上的热心。
sentences: Many of these themes can be found in her new novel, The Magician of Hoad.
其中许多主题都出现在她的新小说《胡德魔术师》中。

The book was begun more than 15 years ago and envisioned as an ‘entire’ fantasy — one set in a fully imagined world with detailed history and complex tribal inter-relationships, a classical hero quest at its heart.
这本书是15年前开始的，被认为是一个“全美”的幻想——它是一个充满了详细历史和复杂的部落相互关系的完全想象的世界，是古典英雄的追求。
The story ballooned at one point to 800 pages and has been through at least two substantial rewrites.
故事在一瞬间升至800页，至少经过了两次实质性重写。
Now half its original size, it is a fascinating read — an adventure, a romance, and a gold mine of Mahy literary preoccupations.
现在，它有一半的原始尺寸，是一个令人着迷的读物—— 一个冒险，一个浪漫，和一个金矿 Mahy文学上的热心。

paragraphs.brief: 也许比其他任何作品都更像，泡泡麻烦是新西兰儿童及其父母所熟知的马希，一个小丑的滚动故事，他扮演着充满欢乐的文字游戏和意想不到的押韵。
sentences: The other splendid Mahy publication this year is a re-issue of Bubble Trouble in a now-illustrated edition.
玛希今年的另一部精彩出版物是配上插图后重新发行的《泡泡惹麻烦》。
This tongue-twister tale first appeared in 1991, was included in 100 New Zealand Poems (1993) and has been recited by Mahy at countless private and public functions.
这个舌头故事最早出现在1991年，列入100个新西兰诗(1993年)，马希在无数私人和公共场合朗诵。

Perhaps more than any other work, Bubble Trouble is the Mahy that New Zealand children and their parents know so well, the rollicking story of a clown who serves up a joyous torrent of word-play and unexpected rhyme.
也许比其他任何作品都更像，泡泡麻烦是新西兰儿童及其父母所熟知的马希，一个小丑的滚动故事，他扮演着充满欢乐的文字游戏和意想不到的押韵。

paragraphs.brief: 这些联系现在有四五个深。
sentences: Those connections are four or five deep now.
这些联系现在有四五个深。

I read The Lion in the Meadow in the School Journal in the late 1960s; my step-daughter listened to The Boy Who Was Followed Home over and over in the 1970s; my own children sat very still mouthing The Great White Man-Eating Shark in the 80s and 90s; now, in the 21st century, my grandchildren have heard Down the Dragon’s Tongue, A Summery Saturday Morning and Dashing Dog many times.
1960年代末期，我在《学校日报》上读到了《狮子在草原》;我的继女听了《1970年代跟随回家的男孩》，我自己的孩子在80年代和90年代仍然不停地说着《大白人吃鲨鱼》;现在，在21世纪，我的孙子们多次听到龙舌头、夏天的星期六早晨和戴青狗的声音。

paragraphs.brief: 当然，读者对任何工作作家来说都很重要，但Mahy对阅读行为的赞誉不止于此：她经常说，书在读完之前没有完成，因为读者给这本书带来了重要的东西。
sentences: Of course, readers are important to any working writer, but Mahy’s espousal of the act of reading goes beyond that: a book is not properly finished, she has often said, until it has been read, because a reader brings something important to the book.
当然，读者对任何工作作家来说都很重要，但Mahy对阅读行为的赞誉不止于此：她经常说，书在读完之前没有完成，因为读者给这本书带来了重要的东西。

So, doubtless out of need to build a market — she’s not ignorant of her popularity — but also out of genuine care for that other dynamic part of the author-reader relationship, Mahy has, until recently, kept up a punishing schedule of public appearances.
所以，毫无疑问，为了建立一个市场，她并不无知她的受欢迎程度，也因为真正关心作者-读者关系中的另一部分，Mahy直到最近才保留了公开露面的惩罚计划。

paragraphs.brief: 与Mahy的私人对话一直是一场狂野的旅程——从字面上讲，这是令人惊奇的，是饥饿的脑袋的产物，也是令人吃惊的无限能力。
sentences: Private conversation with Mahy has always been a wild ride — marvellous, in the true sense of the word, the product of a hungry head and an infinite capacity to be astonished.
与Mahy的私人对话一直是一场狂野的旅程——从字面上讲，这是令人惊奇的，是饥饿的脑袋的产物，也是令人吃惊的无限能力。
She races away at one stage to consult an encyclopaedia for L. M. Montgomery’s date of death, and speculates about the ‘real’ Montgomery, creator of the ever-popular Anne of Green Gables.
她在一个阶段跑去咨询蒙哥马利死亡日的百科全书，并猜测“真实的”蒙哥马利，创造永远流行的绿色吉布尔斯的安妮。
Although I’d come to talk about her new book, I couldn’t help but be captivated by her infectious curiosity.
虽然我是来谈她的新书的但我忍不住被她传染性的好奇心所吸引着

paragraphs.brief: 他的故事对Mahy的愿景评论很好。
sentences: A few years ago, the writer David Hill told a funny story.
几年前作家大卫希尔讲了一个有趣的故事
Though his writing was, he conceded, very different from Mahy’s, he had been affected by her peculiarly alert way of looking at the world, particularly the mad, slippery life of language.
虽然他的写作与马希的写作有很大不同，他却受到她特别警觉地看待世界的方式的影响，特别是语言的疯狂、滑稽的生活。
Once, Hill said, in a motel room, a sign on a door caught his eye: ‘This door is alarmed.’
Hill曾经说，在汽车旅馆房间里，门上的标志吸引了他的眼睛：`这扇门很震惊。'
Mahy would like that, thought Hill.
Mahy会喜欢的以为是Hill

She would enjoy the comedy just below the surface of the formal warning; she would leap immediately to the possibilities for story and language play: ‘Yes, and this window is concerned, this light fitting is irritated.’
她会喜欢在正式警告的表面下方的喜剧；她会立刻跳到故事和语言游戏的可能性上：“是的，这扇窗户很担心，这盏灯的装饰很刺激。”
His story was a wonderful comment on Mahy’s vision.
他的故事对Mahy的愿景评论很好。

items.en: Mahy explores the traditional themes of New Zealand literature.
items.zh: 玛格丽特·梅希探讨了新西兰文学的传统主题。
items.why: Mahy 是否探讨传统的新西兰文学主题。

items.en: Mahy’s children’s books have been more popular than her teenage books.
items.zh: 梅希为儿童写的书比她为青少年写的书更受欢迎。
items.why: 作者分别肯定玛希儿童小说的语言和青少年小说对人性的探索，没有以销量、读者人数或其他标准比较两者谁更受欢迎。

items.en: Mahy and Knox have sometimes criticised each other’s work.
items.zh: 梅希与诺克斯有时批评对方的作品。
items.why: 把诺克斯称作玛希的文学继承者，是评论者对两人创作的比较。文中没有记载两位作家曾互相评论或批评。
作者说玛希愿意给记者充分的时间和注意力，并认真作答，这些行为说明她善待采访者。

items.en: Mahy is at ease speaking about her experiences.
items.zh: 谈到自己的经历时，梅希很自在。
items.why: Mahy 谈论自己经历时是否自在。

groups.label: 观点判断 · YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

items.en: Mahy’s determination to earn a living from writing has encouraged her to find the ideas for her work in ________ places.
items.zh: 玛希决心靠写作谋生，这促使她到一些 ________ 的地方去寻找创作灵感。

items.en: The stories themselves are set in locations that are ________.
items.zh: 这些故事的发生地点具有 ________ 的特点。
items.why: 同时包含奇异与普通地点。

items.en: In terms of characterisation, almost all of her books feature unruly people, and very often an adolescent who possesses ________ abilities.
items.zh: 就人物塑造而言，玛希的书几乎都有不守规矩的人物，还常有一名具备 ________ 能力的青少年。

items.en: Finally, the endings of the stories tend to be ________.
items.why: 结尾可预见但令人满足。

groups.label: 选词填空
groups.instructionsZh: 阅读带空格的中译，回想正确词项及其字母。

items.en: What does the writer say about The Magician of Hoad?
items.zh: 作者如何介绍《霍德的魔法师》这本书？
correct: It was restructured in the writing process.
这本书的结构在写作过程中经过调整。

items.en: According to the writer, Bubble Trouble
items.zh: 按作者的说法，《泡泡闹翻天》是一本怎样的书？
correct: is an old favourite for many families.
许多家庭多年来一直喜爱这本书。

items.en: The writer’s purpose in the fifth paragraph is to
items.zh: 作者写第五段的目的是什么？
correct: illustrate Mahy’s popularity with generations of children.
说明好几代孩子都喜欢梅希。

items.en: According to the sixth paragraph, which of the following is true?
items.zh: 根据第六段，下列哪种说法成立？
correct: Readers are necessary in order to complete a book.
一本书要有读者的参与才算完成。

items.en: What is the writer doing in the final paragraph?
items.zh: 最后一段中，作者在做什么？
correct: illustrating Mahy’s view of the world
阐释梅希如何看待世界。

pairs: 两处都指马希靠创作维持生计。
题干说写作期间重构了作品，原文用至少两次大幅改写来说明。
第 2 段 · 第 7 句
points: 把诺克斯称作玛希的文学继承者，是评论者对两人创作的比较。文中没有记载两位作家曾互相评论或批评。
结尾可预见但令人满足。
clauses: Her junior and picture books are peppered with pirates, robbers and lions, ….
连接词 though 引出“though they appear alongside librarians, mothers and children, working against comfortable stereotype”，说明主句的让步关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 though 把这一层关系补进去。
Another common feature is that, …, they leave the reader feeling absolutely complete, the moral questions resulting from our hero’s powers having been resolved.
连接词 while 引出“while the conclusions of her tales are usually predictable”，说明主句的时间或对比关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 while 把这一层关系补进去。
